card.name: Dose reduction wording after toxicity
card.fires_on: The word reduce (or decrease) in dose-modification instructions, usually right after withhold dose or a toxicity grade. Also nearby spots in the same setting, such as the space before a percent figure or the word narrow before therapeutic range.

modes.label: The wording about reducing or decreasing the dose
modes.description: The verb reduce or decrease starts an instruction to lower the dose after a toxicity.
modes.example: Withhold dose,<< reduce>> dose, or permanently discontinue LUT
